import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModulesTensorPowers
import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.StructureSheafModuleK.ModulesFunctor
import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Ledger.GenusBridge

/-!
# The section-rank bound for the divisor Grassmannian

The Riemann inequality bounds the rank of the actual global-section module
of a line bundle presented by a divisor.  Its tensor-power form supplies the
ambient-rank inequality in campaign D2 after choosing the uniform exponent.
No degree-d divisor family is needed to establish this bound.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

attribute [local instance] moduleKSections

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The Riemann inequality for the global sections of an actual line bundle
with divisor presentation `O(A)`. -/
theorem degree_add_one_sub_genus_le_finrank_sections
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (L : C.left.Modules) :
    letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
    ∀ (A : C.left.CurveDivisor) (_ : L ≅ divisorModules k A),
      CurveDivisor.deg k A + 1 - (genus C : ℤ) ≤
        (Module.finrank k Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) : ℤ) := by
  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
  intro A e
  let E := (toModuleKSheafOfModulesFunctor C).mapIso e ≪≫
    divisorModulesFieldSheafIso k C A
  let E0 : Sheaf.HModule (C.left.divisorSheaf k A) 0 ≃ₗ[k]
      Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) :=
    (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv E.symm 0).trans
      (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology C.left.toTopCat)
        (isTerminalTop : IsTerminal (⊤ : C.left.Opens))
        (toModuleKSheafOfModules C L))
  have h := riemann_inequality_genus C A
  simpa only [Sheaf.h0, E0.finrank_eq] using h

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The section rank of the same tensor power used in the D2 Grassmannian
comparison is bounded below by its divisor degree and the curve's genus. -/
theorem tensorPow_degree_add_one_sub_genus_le_finrank_sections
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]
    (L : C.left.Modules) :
    letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
    ∀ (A : C.left.CurveDivisor) (_ : L ≅ divisorModules k A) (n : ℕ),
      (n : ℤ) * CurveDivisor.deg k A + 1 - (genus C : ℤ) ≤
        (Module.finrank k Γ(Modules.tensorPow L n, (⊤ : C.left.Opens)) : ℤ) := by
  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
  intro A e n
  have h := degree_add_one_sub_genus_le_finrank_sections C
    (Modules.tensorPow L n) (n • A)
    (Modules.tensorPowCongr e n ≪≫ divisorModulesTensorPowIso k A n)
  simpa only [CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul] using h

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
